items.title: Masked Anime
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Stay safe and incognito with these fancy mask outfits made for anime and fashion fans! Everyone wears masks and it's a way to stand out!

+ 12 Masked Anime skins

items.title: Fairy Magic
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Look at all these beautiful fairies fly through the forest! They have an adorable little village in the trees. They are always looking for more members too! Join them in the skies and in the forest today!

- 10 magical fairy skins

items.title: Emojis in Suits
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These suits look clean! Emojis in suits make one amazing combo. Which funny face will you choose? How are you feeling today? Make your emotions obvious with these skins!

- 11 skins

items.title: Neon Gamer Mobs
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Gamer mobs that are neon and glow in the dark look super cool. Which neon color will you choose to show off your gamer spirit?

- 18 mob skins

items.title: Mob Hoodies
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Dress as a mob and blend in with these funky mob hoodies.

- Ten unique mob hoodies
- Fifty skins total

items.title: Floral Thrift Store
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Cute outfits? A fresh look? A love of flowers? All can be found here for an affordable price at the floral thrift shop! Show off your smart buying skills while being trendy and fun with this skin pack!

- 8 Thrifty Skins
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Vegas Knights
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Viva las Knights of Las Vegas! The skins are on vacation and living large in their glowing armor and neon styles. 15 colorful, future medieval skins to choose from.

items.title: Arcade Robots
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Jump into the world of neon glowing robots and fluorescent retro fun! 15 skins bringing you a variety of colors and designs to choose from.

items.title: Miners
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Participate in major excavations around the world with these skins and mine many rare ores!

+ 12 exclusive and detailed skins!
+ Several miners!

items.title: Fruits
items.creator: Senior Studios
items.description:
Fruits! Come and see these wonderful and delicious fruits for you to taste! So delicious..

- 12 fruits skins
- Fresh fruits

items.title: Bears
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
How do you feel about being the cutest bear in your world? Enjoy this cute skin pack now and play with your friends on the maps with the most adorable bears!

* Very cute!
* 8 different bears!
* Very beautiful too!
* Enjoy!

items.title: Spring Village
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Make your way through the spring village and enjoy its magical nature!
Relax and contemplate the beautiful, green landscape!

+ A cute, lively spring village, perfect for a refreshing experience!
+ Have fun with your friends and start your new survival adventure, today!

items.title: Medieval Village
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Turn back time and enjoy the medieval vibes, in your own kingdom!
Honour the ancient knights and expand your empire!

+ A perfect place for all the brave warriors!
+ Lead the medieval village to prosperity and build your own nation!

items.title: Cute Animal Zombie
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Become a little zombie who carries cute animals with this skin pack.

Be a cute little zombie and carry 12 different animals and surprise your friends!
As a little zombie you can, for example, carry around a pig, a cat, a rabbit and much more with you.

- Contains zombie who carries 12 different cute animals
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Burning Demons
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
These magical demons are ready for battle! Some excel in the arcane arts. While others are masters of flight! And we even have some adept with fire magic! Enjoy these cool and creepy skins perfect for all you roleplaying needs!

- 10 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug and Pixel Knight

items.title: RGB Anime Demon Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Do you love RGB's? Roleplay in a skin pack that has anime demon skins with RGB colors! Light up the night with this lit skin pack!

items.title: Daily Anime Life
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to continue your daily life with the cutest Anime skins? Just choose your favorite skin and get started. All other players will have their eyes on you!

+ 10 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Anime themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Skins of the Month August
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These 14 skins are here to bring you a magical August life. Virgo goddesses, Leo lions, beach pandas, peaches, sunflowers, and more! Perfect for the beach, party, back-to-school or just some simple summer fun.

items.title: Glitch
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
These skins are a glitch! Pick a side and look cool with aesthetic armor and masks to match. Have fun with friends and find your next favorite skin today!

+ 12 skins
+ 1 free skin

items.title: Emo Style
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Be among the coolest emo teens in the world! Emo style is in fashion and these modern skin designs are truly cool. 

+ 12 skins
+ Unique styles
+ Colorful options

items.title: Infinity Dungeon
items.creator: Mythicus
items.description:
Fight through an infinite amount of custom dungeons filled with loot, intense battles, and bosses. 
Play with your friends and see how far you can make it!

- Custom weapons!
- New monsters and 3 bosses.
- Shops!
- Custom music and sounds!
- Supports multiplayer.
- Complete achievements.

items.title: Cyber Glitch
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Look the part for a cybernetic world with these glitched skins!

BZZ... are you ready for the future?

- HD
- 10 galactic skins!
- 1 FREE skin: Charged

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: REALISM SKYBLOCK
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
REALISM SKYBLOCK adds a whole new level of realism to the ultimate skyblock challenge!

+ Torches light up in your hand
+ Realism sky, moon, sun and clouds
+ Only works in the world provided

items.title: New Mobs!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
This world adds new mobs in the world!

Includes advanced mobs:
- Wisp
- Minitaur
- Apple Turtle
- Gol
- Pupjaw
- Ent

Great for survival or roleplay!
